name: hackkit
tagline: Messy input in, checked answers out

hero.title: Turn messy input into answers you can trust
hero.lede: An LLM reads the document. Plain, tested code does the math and flags anything a human should check. Every number shows where it came from.

impact_note: Replace with one real number for your problem.

steps.title: Paste or drop the input
steps.text: Text, an image or a PDF: a receipt, a form, a bill.

steps.title: The model reads it
steps.text: Fields come back validated against a schema, with the model's own confidence.

steps.title: Code checks it
steps.text: Deterministic rules do the math and flag anything that does not add up.
